note: Larkspur's planning numbers for a teaching simulator, not measurements of any real queue, worker or courier. Every count the Queues module shows comes from these and from the morning in day.json.

words.service: a parcel job takes a worker 2 minutes and the pallet 4: slowed down so you can watch it; real jobs take milliseconds to seconds
words.outage: while the courier’s site struggles, 4 calls in 5 fail; which ones is a fixed roll of the dice, the same every time
words.restart: a worker knocked over is back on its feet 3 minutes later
words.backoff: with backoff a job waits 1, 2, 4, 8 minutes before each new try; with jitter, a random part of that
words.fail: a call to the courier that fails gives up after 1 minute
